scope: the two tissues that docs/TISSUE_COVERAGE_DECLARATION.md declares as gaps (lens, iris): the author-side class names that were absent from the vocabulary, carrying their own Cell Ontology terms
status: staging only; library `lensiris_v11` is NOT merged into the default `all` set
cl_release: Cell Ontology (CL) OBO, cl-base.obo mirror (release used at index time)
scope_tissues_provenance: docs/TISSUE_COVERAGE_DECLARATION.md declares exactly lens and iris as gaps; the three entries were built from those two volumes' author-declared populations. Nothing wider is claimed, and the range is not yet confirmed by a source independent of this wave's effect data.

entries.provenance: candidate genes harvested from the project RAG corpus (3,869 papers) restricted to symbols present in the assay; identity segment ranked by paper support, discrimination segment by target-vs-neighbour detection ratio
entries.caveat: development-set reading: the discrimination segment was filtered on the same volume it is reported on; not an unbiased performance estimate

entries.cl_overlap_note: CL:0000529 is the parent of CL:0002303 pigmented ciliary epithelial cell, which the antseg_v10 entry already carries. Following the recorded ruling 'merge at equal level, keep separate across levels', this parent-level entry carries no CL scoring key and is never folded into the ciliary label. It also denotes the same cells as the antseg_v10 `iris pigment epithelial cell` entry (CL:0002565, a different ontology branch); in the iris volume the author's own term for those cells is CL:0000529, so this entry is the one that can match it exactly. Decision recorded in LENSIRIS_REPORT; one line reverts it.
